title: AI-drafted sections of The Weekly
description:
Needs Papyrus: the roundup issue gets AI-drafted sections from the snapshot and the approved stories: lead essay, what moved on the map, concepts born this week, top proposal, Underrated.

It keeps the existing admin approval; any edit after approval sends it back to draft.

Acceptance: one issue goes out with AI-drafted, editor-approved sections to the test inbox.
